extraction_environment.note: the pickles are openable only under a pre-1.3 sklearn; 1.3 changed the tree node dtype

provenance.lineage: Random forest for the GSK3B/JNK3 multi-property task of Jin et al. (RationaleRL); redistributed by TDC as oracle/jnk3.pkl and called by MOLLEO through tdc.Oracle. This copy was vendored, at TDC's own relative path oracle/, in the HN-GFN repository.
provenance.identity_evidence: 2048 input features, classes_ [0., 1.], 100 trees, sklearn 0.21.3 -- matching TDC's code path exactly (AllChem.GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect(mol, 2, nBits=2048) then predict_proba[:, 1]). NOT the 1024-feature HN-GFN variant of the same task.

orientation_check.meaning: predict_proba[:, 1] must be HIGHER on known actives. If this is negative the objective is inverted.

tdc_provenance.what_is_established: These artifacts match TDC's oracle contract on every checkable structural detail -- 2048 input features, classes_ [0., 1.], 100 trees, sklearn 0.21.3, sitting at TDC's own relative path oracle/<name>.pkl -- and the frozen numpy evaluators reproduce them bit-for-bit.
tdc_provenance.what_is_NOT_established: That these pickle files are byte-identical to the files TDC serves. Until that is checked against the host, do not describe this bundle as 'verified TDC oracles'.

download_attempts.diagnosis: The host is reachable but answers every non-browser request with an AWS WAF challenge: HTTP 202, empty body. Not maintenance -- a bot filter. A browser session or a mirror would settle it.

tdc_provenance.how_to_settle_it: Download oracle/jnk3.pkl and oracle/gsk3b.pkl from Harvard Dataverse (datafile ids 4170293 and 4170295) through a browser, sha256 them, and compare with the pickle_sha256 recorded here.
